newsitem.title: USA: Medtronic sees FY97 EPS near $2.27 a share.
newsitem.headline: Medtronic sees FY97 EPS near $2.27 a share.

text.p: Medtronic Inc chairman and chief executive William George said on Wednesday the company's earnings per share for fiscal 1997 would be close to $2.27 compared to $1.88 in fiscal 1996.
"We'll be in that range of $2.27," George said following the company's annual meeting here.

George also said he expected revenues from pacemaker sales to grow 15 percent in fiscal 1997. That business, the medical device giant's largest, grew about 15 percent in the first quarter "and we expect to maintain that in 1997," he said.
George added that the growth projection is based on a constant currency. About 43 percent of the medical device company's business is from outside the United States.
The company expects strong growth in revenues and earnings from its neurological and vascular businesses, he said.

"We expect continued strong growth (in revenues) in neurological. Our vascular business is also growing rapidly and we expect that to continue," he said. "We'll probably see the largest percentage increase in earnings in the neurological business, or possibly in the vascular business."

Arthur Collins, president and chief operating officer, told shareholders research and development was budgeted to be in excess of $290 million for the fiscal year that ends in April, compared to $237 million in fiscal 1996.
